caption: The drawing consists of a single object resembling a scoop or ladle, shown in a three-dimensional, shaded graphite rendering centered within a square border on a cream-colored paper. The object is elongated and shallow with an oval bowl and a smoothly tapered, slightly upturned spout on the right side. On the lower left of the composition, outside the main square border, there is a smaller sketch showing a simple side profile of the object, annotated with dimensions; the width is marked as "5 1/4" and the height as "1 1/2." The larger central depiction uses a gradient of gray tones to indicate the curvature and depth of the object, with darker shading along the lower and outer edges. The artist’s signature, "F. Álvarez," appears below the right corner of the primary square border. The overall composition is monochromatic, using varying shades of gray pencil on an aged, yellowish background.
title: Silver Pap Boat
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
